package_metadata.description:
# napari-aigifmaker

Turn text into animated GIFs with AI GIF Maker. Native GIF generation — no video conversion. Type what you want and download your GIF in about a minute.

This napari plugin adds an **AI GIF Maker** dock widget inside your viewer: enter a prompt and an optional `AIGIFMAKER_API_KEY`, press **Generate GIF**, and load the animated GIF frame stack directly as a napari image layer (with the source URL stored in `layer.metadata["aigifmaker_url"]`).

## Install

```bash
pip install napari-aigifmaker
```

Or install inside napari via **Plugins -> Install/Uninstall Plugins**.

## Usage

1. Create an API key at [AI GIF Maker API Keys](https://aigifmaker.ai/settings/apikeys) or try the anonymous allowance.
2. Open **Plugins -> napari-aigifmaker -> AI GIF Maker** in napari.
3. Describe the motion and scene, click **Generate GIF**, and scrub through the returned frames along axis 0.

Useful links:
- [AI GIF Maker](https://aigifmaker.ai/?utm_source=napari&utm_medium=package)
- [Documentation](https://aigifmaker.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
- [Pricing & Credits](https://aigifmaker.ai/pricing?utm_source=napari&utm_medium=package)
